slides.say: Setting state inside an Effect with no dependencies is like plugging a power strip into itself.
The Effect runs after render and sets state. Setting state triggers a render. That runs the Effect again. Forever.

slides.text: A loop needs two things: the Effect sets state, and that render changes its dependencies.
slides.say: Any infinite loop needs two things: the Effect updates some state, and that re-render changes the Effect’s dependencies again.

slides.text: No external system? You probably don’t need the Effect at all.
slides.say: Ask why the Effect sets state. Effects are for syncing with external systems. If you are only adjusting state from other state, you might not need an Effect.
